ambiguities.summary: No typed effect matches this item. The rules listed under Not modeled stay text only.

usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.text:
_Potion, Rare_

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the _Gaseous Form_ spell for 1 hour (no Concentration required) or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.

This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.
